seo.description: Sample project: weekly lawn and bed care for a Gordon Head home in Saanich, with moss control, pruning and fall leaf cleanup on one plan. Get a free quote.

summary: Regular lawn and bed care for a busy household with a large mossy lawn.
scope: Weekly mowing in spring, every other week in summer
duration: Ongoing, March to November with winter cleanups
story: The lawn under two big Douglas-firs was more moss than grass, and the owners had no time for weekends in the yard.
We set a visit schedule, raised the mowing height, and aerated and overseeded the sunnier areas in fall. In the deepest shade we suggested a mulched bed of native groundcover instead of more lawn.
Read more about [grounds maintenance](/services/grounds-maintenance/), see our work in [Saanich](/areas/saanich/), or [get a free quote](/quote/).
result: A lawn plan matched to the shade, and a schedule the family did not have to manage.
